items.label: Email provider
items.description: Which bridge sends email: smtp or resend. Leave blank to turn email off.
items.long_description: Plugins ask the kernel to send an email and the kernel hands it to this provider. Fill in the provider's own group (SMTP, Resend) below. An organization can pick its own provider and credentials; otherwise it uses the global ones.

items.label: From address
items.description: The address emails are sent from, such as no-reply@example.com.
items.long_description: Plugins cannot choose the sender. The provider must be allowed to send from this address.

items.label: From name
items.description: The name shown beside the address.

items.label: SMS provider
items.description: Which bridge sends text messages: twilio, termii or africas_talking. Leave blank to turn SMS off.
items.long_description: Fill in the provider's own group below. An organization can pick its own provider and credentials; otherwise it uses the global ones.

items.label: Sender name or number
items.description: Overrides the provider's own sender, when it allows one per message.

items.label: SMTP server
items.description: The mail server, such as smtp.example.com.

items.label: SMTP username
items.description: Leave blank for a server that needs no login.

items.label: SMTP password
items.description: Stored encrypted; it is never shown again.

items.label: SMTP security
items.description: starttls (port 587), tls (port 465) or none (port 25, unencrypted).

items.label: SMTP port
items.description: Leave blank to use the usual port for the security setting.

items.label: Resend API key
items.description: From resend.com; stored encrypted.

items.label: Twilio account SID
items.description: Starts with AC.

items.label: Twilio auth token
items.description: Stored encrypted; it is never shown again.

items.label: Twilio from number
items.description: A Twilio number in international form, such as +15551234567.

items.label: Termii API key
items.description: Stored encrypted; it is never shown again.

items.label: Termii sender ID
items.description: The sender name registered with Termii.

items.label: Termii channel
items.description: generic, dnd or whatsapp.

items.label: Termii API address
items.description: Termii shows the address for your account in its dashboard.

items.label: Africa's Talking username
items.description: Your Africa's Talking username (sandbox for testing).

items.label: Africa's Talking API key
items.description: Stored encrypted; it is never shown again.

items.label: Africa's Talking sender ID
items.description: Optional sender name registered with Africa's Talking.

items.label: Africa's Talking API address
items.description: Use https://api.sandbox.africastalking.com to test.

items.label: Run background jobs
items.description: Turn off to pause scheduled tasks and queued jobs for an organization.
items.long_description: Jobs and tasks stay queued while this is off and run when it is turned back on.

items.label: Attempts per job
items.description: How many times a failing job is tried before it is marked failed.

items.label: First retry delay (seconds)
items.description: The wait before the second attempt; it doubles after each failure, up to six hours.

items.label: Keep finished jobs (days)
items.description: Successful jobs older than this are deleted.

items.label: Keep failed jobs (days)
items.description: Failed and cancelled jobs are kept longer so they can be looked at.
